notes: First 2k/200/300 is an early milestone; realistic current goal is cumulative 5k/500/800 (pilot 150 separate).
At 5k train, 12 prompts and four candidates each imply 240k base candidate texts, plus blind audits. Real throughput and accepted samples are measured in pilot.
Do not automatically plan 10k/50k/100k; any further expansion requires a new evidence-based decision.
A trained evaluator and GPU RL are not prerequisites for offline data generation, but independent semantic review is required.
The CLI init stage only creates planned seeds; use --offset and separate --out directories for resumable shards.
Extra evaluator calibration negatives and retries are separate from four-grid counts.
All numerical targets are planning decisions, not measured quality or performance.
split_policy: Freeze source/template groups before generation; hold back test from model-guided generation and reuse.
scale_up_decision_signals: measured total model calls and token cost per audited family
